changes: Core engine changes: one scene type for the game and the editor, Stage for a scene's view side, Pool and handles for things that come and go.
Editor: scenes open again in projects that name a font.

breaking.change: EditorScene, GameObject, ObjectList, AddObject and ShutdownNoThrow are gone; Scene::Update runs on game time by default.
FxStage::Update is split into UpdateReal and Update; ColliderRef and ColliderHit carry layers; Core/Progress moved to Core/Gameplay.
